categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Fuzzing label, modifies test utilities and fuzz harnesses in `src/test/` to initialize block filter indexes for P2P message fuzzing.
categories.rationale: Extends fuzz harnesses to cover previously ignored BIP 157 P2P messages and fixes a test teardown use-after-free. Test infrastructure guidelines prioritize coverage of high-risk code paths like P2P message handling, and this coverage immediately reproduced an integer overflow issue in `net_processing`.
